events.text: Maybank's sustainable finance disclosures for the period from 1 January 2024 to 31 December 2024 were subjected to independent limited assurance by PricewaterhouseCoopers PLT, Malaysia (PwC), with details on pages 151 and 152.
Maybank Group's Sustainability Report 2024, externally assured by SIRIM QAS International, includes sustainability disclosures for the financial year 2024 covering the Group's global operations.

Bank Negara Malaysia imposed an Administrative Monetary Penalty of RM4.32 million against Malayan Banking Bhd and Maybank for non-compliance with the Financial Services Act 2013 and Islamic Financial Services Act 2013 due to prolonged disruptions of several banking services, on 29 July 2024.
Maybank Islamic Bhd, a unit of Malayan Banking Bhd, was fined RM1.2 million by Bank Negara Malaysia for failing to comply with financial services laws, as reported on May 28.
